title: Fabricate
description:
You follow the recipe for a piece of equipment: the one its entry prints, or the one the GM sets for an item or a change you put to them.

Commit materials that cover each Type it asks for and whose Material Values add up to its cost or more. A material counts for only one of its Types. The materials are used up as soon as you commit them.

Then make the recipe's {{jet|Rolls}} in order, each with the {{caracteristique}} and {{dd}} it gives and the recipe's discipline as the {{aptitude}}. If they all succeed, the piece is made. At the first failure the work stops and the materials are lost.
